text:
evan (Design): quick opinion check: for the Permissions form do we use inline errors, a floating compact summary bar, or both? also debating whether the required marker should be an asterisk or a small 'Required' pill next to the label. attaching tiny mock: https://drive.redwood.design/ux/permissions-form-v2.png :point_up: priya (PM): my vote: inline for field-level rules, floating summary bar if submit fails with >1 error. floating bar keeps header visible and is less scary than a modal. :ballot_box_with_check: nate (A11y): accessibility: floating bar must be focusable and announced (role=alert). asterisk-only is ambiguous for screen readers; prefer sr-only "required" text or aria-required. pills are ok but ensure contrast. claire (Frontend): building floating bar is doable; will need anchor links to jump to field. small code pattern:
3 issues
then anchors. inline errors on blur is straightforward. owen (ENG): backend note: server-side validation (e.g., scope conflict) should surface in the floating bar and attach to the input via aria-describedby. also add a 1.5s debounce on saves so floating bar doesn't flicker on transient states. zuri (Design Ops): mobile: floating bar eats real estate. maybe show inline on mobile and only show floating bar on tablet/desktop. error copy should be one-liners on narrow screens. priya (PM): delete flow question: workspace-level delete — typed-confirm, name match, or confirm modal + delay? I'm leaning typed-confirm for high-risk. evan (Design): proposal: use inline validation as-you-type for simple constraints. On submit, if multiple problems, reveal a floating compact summary bar with linked bullets to fields. Required marker: visible asterisk + sr-only 'required' text to support SRs. Delete: require the exact workspace slug (typed-confirm) for org deletes; for item-level deletes use confirm + 10s undo snackbar. nate (A11y): +1, small nit: ensure the floating bar traps focus briefly so screen readers land on it. also ensure keyboard users can dismiss and navigate to errors with the links. I'll run a quick audit once PR is ready. :white_check_mark: claire (Frontend): edge-case: users with long forms and many errors — floating bar should show top 3 errors and a "Show all" collapsible. will prototype that behavior. owen (ENG): agree re: server errors mapping. also add idempotency token for delete API so typed-confirm can't be double-submitted. ez (ux-buddy): accessibility-bot: checks recommended: role=alert on floating bar, sr-only required labels, keyboard focus management, color contrast >= 4.5:1 for error text. zuri (Design Ops): next steps: evan will update mocks for desktop/tablet/mobile variants and include floating bar states; claire will prototype anchor behavior; nate to run the audit after mocks. sync 9:30am tomorrow. :calendar:
